name: Mira
source:
A former magic school drop out. She can be short tempered and doesn't take criticism well. Unfortunately, this leads her into making some rash decisions. On the other hand, her stubbornness has led her to accomplish some impressive things -- even if they weren't intended.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=21471]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
